assets.name: nav-dashboard
assets.model: Not exposed in returned result; no model claimed
assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: production bitmap navigation icon, nav-dashboard, for Bivaro financial SaaS sidebar.
Primary request: exactly ONE minimal dashboard icon: four calm solid rounded-square dashboard tiles arranged in a balanced 2-by-2 grid, with generous even transparent gutters. No other icon or element.
Style/medium: contemporary state-of-the-art flat 2D minimal financial-SaaS navigation glyph, simple geometric silhouette, gently rounded corners. This belongs to a coordinated set also containing receipt/check, document/pen, bell, and two-people icons.
Composition/framing: square canvas, centered, outer visual bounds approximately 72% of canvas width and height, balanced optical weight, recognizable when displayed at 28px.
Color palette: pure solid opaque black silhouette ONLY with genuinely transparent background and transparent negative spaces. This PNG will be used as an alpha mask and rendered currentColor in dark and light modes. Antialiased edges are fine.
Constraints: one icon only, filled bold geometric forms rather than thin strokes; consistent moderate corner rounding; no background tile/frame/container.
Avoid: any 3D, old-fashioned 3D, perspective, gradients, shading, highlights, bevel, shadows, textures, white-filled areas, colored pixels, text, letters, tiny detail, decorative badge, checkerboard baked into image, collage, sprite sheet, contact sheet.
assets.qa: Actual original viewed with view_image; alpha/read-only pixel inspection; separate light-background and magnified 28px QA derivatives; no production editing, no integration or functional tests.
